g.text: Every parameter is optional and passed by name, as in RiseIn(distance=60). The only values passed by
position are the duration of Show and Hide, which is required, and the animations of a Sequence. An exit
takes the same parameters as its entrance.
direction="right", distance=40, fade=True, focus=False, duration=0.8, easing=EaseOutQuint()
direction="right", distance=40, fade=True, focus=False, duration=0.8, easing=EaseInQuint()
start_scale=0.8, fade=True, focus=False, duration=0.6 (no easing parameter)
the animations, in order, and loop_limit=0
How many seconds one run takes. In Show and Hide, how
How the speed changes during the run. See Easings. Not
accepted by PopIn, PopOut, FlickerIn, FlickerOut, GlitchIn,
How many pixels the block travels in RiseIn, DropIn, SlideIn
and their exits. With 0 the block does not move.
The way SlideIn and SlideOut move: with right the block
comes from the left and moves to the right.
Whether the entrance or exit also fades. With False the block is
fully visible while it moves. UnfoldIn and UnfoldOut default to
False, and FadeIn and FadeOut have no such parameter.
Whether the block also starts out of focus, with a blur that
clears as it appears. The exit blurs it again. Safari does not

text.tspan: draw the blur, so there the block only fades.

g.text: How many pixels of blur FocusIn and FocusOut start or end
with.Safari does not draw it: FocusIn and FocusOut only fade
The size PopIn starts from and PopOut ends at, where 1 is the
The size ZoomIn starts from and ZoomOut ends at: 0.5 is half
How far the block turns. In SpinIn and SpinOut, positive is
clockwise. In Sway, how far it swings to each side. In Rotate,
the size of the turn: 360 is a full turn, and a negative value turns
What FlipIn and FlipOut flip. With horizontal the block is
mirrored left to right, passing through zero width. With vertical,
top to bottom, passing through zero height.
The edge that UnfoldIn and UnfoldOut hinge the block to.
A whole number of 1 or more
How many times FlickerIn and FlickerOut blink.
How many pixels GlitchIn and GlitchOut jump sideways.
How strong the movement is. In Pulse, the growth at its peak:
0.06 is 6% bigger. In Float and Shake, the distance in pixels.
In Jelly, the stretch, between 0 and 1: 0.15 is 15%.
A whole number of 1 or more
How many times Shake swings before it stops.
A whole number of 1 or more
How many times Jelly stretches and squashes before it stops.
How wide, in pixels, the figure eight of Drift is.
How many times an ambient animation or a Sequence runs
again after its first run. None means no limit. See Repeating.
